identity.name: Qwen2.5-72B-2x-Instruct-TIES-v1.0
identity.summary: This model is a merge of pre-trained language models created using mergekit.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: merge of two fine-tuned instruct variants of Qwen2.5-72B with no reported evaluations or safety testing in the card -> plausible factual inaccuracies in generated text

specifications.model_size: 135.4 GiB of safetensors weights (145,399,444,488 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was produced by merging abacusai/Dracarys2-72B-Instruct and rombodawg/Rombos-LLM-V2.5-Qwen-72b onto the Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B base using the TIES merge method.
training_context.training_data: The model is a merge of two fine-tuned variants of Qwen2.5-72B: abacusai/Dracarys2-72B-Instruct and rombodawg/Rombos-LLM-V2.5-Qwen-72b.
